verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out or any control that stops Google Calendar data from being used to train AI models. The privacy-related community comments concern ad data harvesting and email scanning, not AI training controls, so they do not count toward this story. The axis applies to a cloud calendar service, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
